platform.description: Target console: psx=Sony PlayStation, saturn=Sega Saturn, dreamcast=Sega Dreamcast, segacd=Sega CD / Mega CD, pcecd=PC Engine CD / TurboGrafx-CD

is_multidisc.description: True if this disc belongs to a multi-disc game release

disc_number.description: Disc number within the set, or single for a standalone release
